questions.q: How do I book a Hajj or Umrah package?
questions.a: You can book by clicking the 'Book Now' button on any package, contacting us via WhatsApp, or visiting our office. A deposit is required to secure your spot. Our team will guide you through the entire process.

questions.q: How far in advance should I book?
questions.a: We recommend booking at least 3-6 months in advance, especially for Hajj packages as they fill up quickly. Umrah packages can be booked 1-3 months ahead for optimal availability.

questions.q: What is the deposit amount to secure my booking?
questions.a: A deposit of $500-$1,000 is required to secure your booking, depending on the package. The remaining balance is due 30-60 days before departure.

questions.q: Can I change my travel dates after booking?
questions.a: Yes, date changes are possible subject to availability. Please contact our team at least 14 days before your departure for assistance with date modifications.

questions.q: Is there a cancellation policy?
questions.a: Yes, cancellations made 60+ days before departure receive a full refund minus processing fees. Cancellations within 30-60 days receive a 50% refund. Within 30 days, fees may apply.

questions.q: What documents are required for Umrah/Hajj visa?
questions.a: You'll need a valid passport (at least 6 months validity), passport-size photos with white background, proof of vaccination (Meningitis and COVID-19 as required), and completed visa application forms. We assist with the entire process.

questions.q: How long does visa processing take?
questions.a: Umrah visas typically take 3-7 business days. Hajj visas may take longer during peak season. We'll handle all documentation for you.

questions.q: Do I need specific vaccinations?
questions.a: Yes, Meningitis vaccination is required for all pilgrims. COVID-19 vaccination may also be required depending on current Saudi regulations. We recommend checking with our team for the latest requirements.

questions.q: Can you help with passport renewal?
questions.a: While we don't directly handle passport renewals, we can provide guidance and resources to help you through the process.

questions.q: How close are the hotels to the Harams?
questions.a: Our packages include hotels ranging from 200m to 1km from the Harams in Makkah and Madinah. Premium packages offer closer proximity, some within walking distance.

questions.q: What hotel amenities are included?
questions.a: Hotels include air conditioning, private bathrooms, WiFi, and daily housekeeping. Breakfast is included; some packages include breakfast and dinner.

questions.q: How is transportation handled during the pilgrimage?
questions.a: All ground transportation between cities (Makkah, Madinah, Mina, Arafat) is included. We use comfortable, air-conditioned luxury buses for all pilgrimages.

questions.q: What if I have special dietary requirements?
questions.a: We work with hotels to accommodate special dietary needs including halal requirements, vegetarian options, and food allergies. Please inform us in advance.

questions.q: Will I have a guide during Hajj?
questions.a: Yes, all our packages include professional guides who are experienced in Hajj rituals and can assist in multiple languages including English, Arabic, and Urdu.

questions.q: What should I pack for Hajj/Umrah?
questions.a: Essential items include Ihram garments (for men), modest clothing, comfortable walking shoes, personal medications, and personal toiletries. We provide a detailed packing list upon booking.

questions.q: Is there WiFi available during the trip?
questions.a: Yes, WiFi is available at most hotels. Mobile data is also available through Saudi carriers. We recommend getting a local SIM card for convenience.

questions.q: What happens if I have a medical emergency?
questions.a: We have emergency contacts and partnerships with local medical facilities. Premium packages include travel insurance with medical coverage. Our team is available 24/7 for support.

questions.q: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.a: We accept bank transfers, credit/debit cards, mobile money (where available), and cash payments at our office. All transactions are secure and documented.

questions.q: Do you offer payment plans?
questions.a: Yes, we offer flexible installment plans for bookings made well in advance. Contact our team to discuss a payment schedule that works for you.

questions.q: Are there any hidden costs?
questions.a: No, we believe in transparent pricing. All inclusions are clearly listed for each package. Personal expenses, additional meals, and optional activities are the only extras you may incur.

questions.q: Is travel insurance included?
questions.a: Travel insurance with comprehensive coverage is included in our premium packages. Basic coverage is available for other packages. We recommend reviewing coverage details before travel.

questions.q: What preparation sessions do you offer?
questions.a: We provide pre-travel lectures covering Hajj/Umrah rituals, spiritual preparation, health tips, and what to expect during your pilgrimage. These sessions are included in all packages.

questions.q: How should I prepare spiritually?
questions.a: We recommend increasing your prayers, reading about Hajj/Umrah rituals, making dua, and seeking knowledge about the significance of each ritual. Our preparation sessions also help with spiritual readiness.

questions.q: Do I need to learn Arabic phrases?
questions.a: While not mandatory, learning basic Arabic phrases for Dua and common interactions can enhance your experience. Our guides also help translate and explain throughout your journey.

questions.q: What health preparations should I make?
questions.a: We recommend a general health checkup before travel, ensuring all vaccinations are up to date, packing necessary medications, and preparing physically with light exercise. Consult your doctor for personalized advice.
